goal: Add a printer to your Mac

steps.title: Open Printers & Scanners settings
steps.explanation: Open System Settings from the Apple menu, then click Printers & Scanners in the sidebar.

steps.title: Start adding a printer
steps.explanation: Click the Add Printer, Scanner or Fax button so your Mac can look for printers nearby.

steps.title: Choose your printer and add it
steps.explanation: Pick your printer from the list shown, then click Add.

steps.title: Check the printer was added
steps.explanation: Run this read-only command in Terminal. If the printer was added, its name will appear in the output.
